name: home1
js: const c=__bw.ctl, T=__bw.THREE; const camp=__bw.scene.getObjectByName('attackerCamp'); if(!camp) return {camp:false}; const bb=new T.Box3(); camp.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh||o.isSprite){ const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(o); if(isFinite(b.min.x)) bb.union(b);} }); const ct=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3()); c.target.x=ct.x; c.target.z=ct.z; c.dist=95; return {camp:true,vis:camp.visible,c:[ct.x|0,ct.z|0],size:bb.getSize(new T.Vector3()).toArray().map(v=>v|0), kids:camp.children.length};

name: start
js: const T={levels:{keep:18,wall:18,towers:18,barracks:12,lair:12},seed:11,ratio:1.1,power:4500,loot:{turq:60,emerald:60,ruby:60},tesla:0,emblem:'swords',name:'Navid'}; __bw.battle.start(T,null,null); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(__bw.battle.session && !__bw.battle.loading) break; } const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.intro=0; return {ok:!!S, camp:!!S.camp, dp:[S.sim.deploy.x|0,S.sim.deploy.z|0]};

name: campdiag
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, T=__bw.THREE; const out=[]; S.camp.group.children.forEach((o,i)=>{ const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(o); const s=b.getSize(new T.Vector3()); out.push([i,o.type,Math.round(s.x),Math.round(s.z),Math.round((b.min.x+b.max.x)/2),Math.round((b.min.z+b.max.z)/2)]); }); const dp=S.sim.deploy; let l0=1e9,l1=-1e9,b0=1e9,b1=-1e9; const tx=-dp.nz,tz=dp.nx; for(const u of S.sim.units){const dx=u.x-dp.x,dz=u.z-dp.z,l=dx*tx+dz*tz,b=dx*dp.nx+dz*dp.nz; l0=Math.min(l0,l);l1=Math.max(l1,l);b0=Math.min(b0,b);b1=Math.max(b1,b);} return {kids:out.slice(0,40),army:[l0|0,l1|0,b0|0,b1|0]};

name: giant0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; const g=sim.units.find(u=>u.type==='giant'); if(!g) return {n:0}; S.cam.tx=g.x; S.cam.tz=g.z; S.cam.dist=16; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+0.55; return {g:[g.x|0,g.z|0]};

name: wade
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim, W=__bw.world; S.started=true; const keep=sim.buildings.find(b=>b.type==='keep'); sim.send('giant',keep.x,keep.z); const g=sim.units.find(u=>u.type==='giant'); let n=0,wet=0; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ sim.step(0.1); if(S.wake) S.wake.update(sim.units,0.1); S.fx.update(0.1,__bw.camera); n++; if(W.fastHeight(g.x,g.z)<-0.3){ wet++; if(wet>=14) break; } } S.cam.tx=g.x; S.cam.tz=g.z; S.cam.dist=20; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+0.55; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; return {g:[g.x|0,g.z|0],n,wet,t:sim.time|0};

name: fight
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.hud.el.style.display=''; for(const t of S.types){ const u=sim.units.find(x=>x.type===t); if(u&&u.air) continue; const keep=sim.buildings.find(b=>b.type==='keep'); sim.send(t,keep.x,keep.z);} for(let i=0;i<260;i++){ sim.step(0.1); } const near=sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead&&Math.hypot(u.x-114,u.z-57)<30).length; S.cam.tx=118; S.cam.tz=62; S.cam.dist=70; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0; return {near,t:sim.time|0,alive:sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead).length};
